```{r}
#| label: params
# Purpose: one-page dashboard of the BMV unmix comparison, built only from the figures the
#          2026-11-11 freshness audit certified as current (Nature-spec restyle). Each section
#          carries the report's finding, then tabs: figures, the plotted data, AutoSpectral notes.
# Run:     pixi run quarto render experiments/benchmarks/05_bmv-unmix-compare/96_dashboard.qmd
#          then move dashboard.html into OUT_DIR (OUT_DIR must not exist before the render).
# Inputs:  experiments/benchmarks/05_bmv-unmix-compare/90_report.qmd   section prose, figure calls, captions
#          experiments/runs/2026-11-10_bmv-summary/INDEX.md              conclusions list
#          experiments/runs/2026-11-11_bmv-restyle/audit_freshness.csv   certified figures (current = TRUE)
#          <figure>.pdf, <figure>.csv beside every cited PNG             [save_panel, 95_restyle_*, report_figures.R]
# Outputs: <OUT_DIR>/img/*.png         WEB_DPI web copies made from each figure's PDF
#          <OUT_DIR>/img_log.csv       figure, source used (pdf or png fallback), web image
#          <OUT_DIR>/sessionInfo.txt
# Parameters --------------------------------------------------------------------
RUNS_DIR <- "experiments/runs"
REPORT_QMD <- "experiments/benchmarks/05_bmv-unmix-compare/90_report.qmd" # section order and prose
INDEX_MD <- "experiments/runs/2026-11-10_bmv-summary/INDEX.md"
AUDIT_CSV <- "experiments/runs/2026-11-11_bmv-restyle/audit_freshness.csv"
FIG_DIR <- "experiments/runs/2026-11-10_bmv-report/figures-v7" # report redraws, as 90_report.qmd
KEPT_DIR <- "experiments/runs/2026-11-11_bmv-restyle" # restyled per-cell and summary figures
OUT_DIR <- "experiments/runs/2026-11-11_bmv-dashboard"
WEB_DPI <- 120 # web copy resolution (150 gave a 17.7 MB page, over the 16 MB publish limit); the 300-dpi PNG and vector PDF stay in the run folders
MAX_ROWS <- 500 # rows shown per data table; larger tables show the first MAX_ROWS
```

```{r}
#| label: setup
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath("../../.."))
```

```{r}
#| label: libraries
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(purrr)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tibble)
  library(reactable)
})
```

```{r}
#| label: sections
# Parse the report into sections --------------------------------------------------------------
# Each "## " heading of 90_report.qmd is one section; prose is every line outside code chunks.
report <- read_lines(REPORT_QMD)
in_chunk <- cumsum(str_detect(report, "^```")) %% 2 == 1 | str_detect(report, "^```")
heading_at <- which(str_detect(report, "^## "))
sections <- tibble(
  start = heading_at,
  end = c(heading_at[-1] - 1, length(report)),
  heading = str_remove(report[heading_at], "^## ")
) |>
  mutate(
    prose = map2_chr(start, end, \(s, e) {
      keep <- (s + 1):e
      keep <- keep[!in_chunk[keep]]
      str_trim(paste(report[keep], collapse = "\n"))
    }),
    code = map2_chr(start, end, \(s, e) {
      keep <- (s + 1):e
      paste(report[keep[in_chunk[keep]]], collapse = "\n")
    })
  )

# Report redraws: key -> title from the FIGURES table; s06 is drawn in the report itself.
redraw_titles <- str_match_all(
  paste(report, collapse = "\n"),
  '"(s\\d\\d_[a-z0-9_]+)"\\s*,\\s*"[^"]*"\\s*,\\s*"[^"]*"\\s*,\\s*"([^"]*)"'
)[[1]]
redraw_titles <- set_names(redraw_titles[, 3], redraw_titles[, 2])
redraw_titles[["s06_spectra_angle"]] <- "Angle between each dye's 1.0.2 and 1.8.8 spectrum; each point is one dye."

# Figures per section, in report order: show("key"), show_kept("path", "caption") and the
# section 05 walk() over x markers, expanded the way the report expands it.
unescape <- \(x) str_replace_all(x, '\\\\"', '"')
section_figures <- \(code) {
  calls <- str_match_all(
    code,
    regex(
      paste0(
        'show\\("(s\\d\\d_[a-z0-9_]+)"\\)',
        '|show_kept\\(\\s*"([^"]+)"\\s*,\\s*"((?:[^"\\\\]|\\\\.)*)"\\s*\\)',
        '|walk\\(c\\(([^)]*)\\),\\s*\\\\\\(x\\) show_kept\\(\\s*sprintf\\("([^"]+)", x\\),\\s*sprintf\\(\\s*"((?:[^"\\\\]|\\\\.)*)",\\s*x\\s*\\)'
      ),
      dotall = TRUE
    )
  )[[1]]
  if (nrow(calls) == 0) {
    return(tibble(path = character(), caption = character()))
  }
  map(seq_len(nrow(calls)), \(i) {
    m <- calls[i, ]
    if (!is.na(m[2])) {
      tibble(path = file.path(FIG_DIR, paste0(m[2], ".png")), caption = redraw_titles[[m[2]]])
    } else if (!is.na(m[3])) {
      tibble(path = file.path(KEPT_DIR, m[3]), caption = unescape(m[4]))
    } else {
      xs <- str_match_all(m[5], '"([^"]+)"')[[1]][, 2]
      tibble(path = file.path(KEPT_DIR, sprintf(m[6], xs)), caption = sprintf(unescape(m[7]), xs))
    }
  }) |>
    list_rbind()
}
figures <- sections |>
  mutate(fig = map(code, section_figures)) |>
  select(heading, fig) |>
  tidyr::unnest(fig) |>
  mutate(
    caption = str_remove(caption, "\\s*(Kept|Restyled) (from|by) .*$"),
    rel = str_remove(path, paste0("^", RUNS_DIR, "/"))
  )

# Only figures the freshness audit certified enter the dashboard.
certified <- read_csv(AUDIT_CSV, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(current) |>
  pull(figure) |>
  unique()
stopifnot("every dashboard figure is certified current" = all(figures$rel %in% certified))
```

```{r}
#| label: web-images
# Web copies of every figure ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Web PNGs rendered at WEB_DPI from each figure's vector PDF; a PNG is downsized only when no PDF exists.
stopifnot("output dir is new" = !dir.exists(OUT_DIR))
dir.create(file.path(OUT_DIR, "img"), recursive = TRUE)
img_log <- figures |>
  distinct(rel, path) |>
  mutate(
    web = file.path(OUT_DIR, "img", str_replace_all(str_remove(rel, "\\.png$"), "/", "__")),
    pdf = str_replace(path, "\\.png$", ".pdf"),
    source = if_else(file.exists(pdf), "pdf", "png")
  )
pwalk(img_log, \(rel, path, web, pdf, source) {
  if (source == "pdf") {
    system2("pdftoppm", c("-r", WEB_DPI, "-png", "-singlefile", shQuote(pdf), shQuote(web)))
  } else {
    # 300-dpi PNG halved to the web resolution
    system2("convert", c(shQuote(path), "-resize", sprintf("%d%%", round(100 * WEB_DPI / 300)), shQuote(paste0(web, ".png"))))
  }
})
img_log <- mutate(img_log, web = paste0(web, ".png"))
stopifnot("every web image was written" = all(file.exists(img_log$web)))
write_csv(select(img_log, rel, source, web), file.path(OUT_DIR, "img_log.csv"))
figures <- left_join(figures, select(img_log, rel, web), by = join_by(rel), relationship = "many-to-one")
```

```{r}
#| label: helpers
# The plotted data of one figure: the source CSV save_panel wrote beside the PNG.
data_table <- \(png) {
  csv <- str_replace(png, "\\.png$", ".csv")
  d <- read_csv(csv, show_col_types = FALSE, guess_max = 5000)
  n <- nrow(d)
  d <- d |>
    head(MAX_ROWS) |>
    mutate(across(where(is.double), \(x) signif(x, 3)))
  note <- if (n > MAX_ROWS) sprintf("First %d of %d rows; full table: `%s`.", MAX_ROWS, n, csv) else sprintf("%d rows; file: `%s`.", n, csv)
  list(
    widget = reactable(
      d,
      searchable = TRUE,
      sortable = TRUE,
      compact = TRUE,
      striped = TRUE,
      defaultPageSize = 10,
      wrap = FALSE,
      resizable = TRUE
    ),
    note = note
  )
}

# AutoSpectral quotes in a section's prose: an inline "AutoSpectral: ..." sentence or quote bullets.
autospectral_notes <- \(prose) {
  inline <- str_extract_all(prose, "AutoSpectral: .*?\\)\\.")[[1]]
  bullets <- str_subset(str_split(prose, "\n")[[1]], "^- .*“")
  c(inline, bullets)
}
finding <- \(prose) {
  prose |>
    str_remove_all("\\s*AutoSpectral: .*?\\)\\.") |>
    str_split("\n") |>
    pluck(1) |>
    discard(\(l) str_detect(l, "^- .*“|^AutoSpectral quotes for this section")) |>
    paste(collapse = "\n") |>
    str_trim()
}
```

> **How to read this page.** Each section states the finding with the figures that support it. Tabs hold the figures (Nature spec, 120-dpi web copies of the vector PDFs), the plotted data behind each figure (sortable and searchable), and the AutoSpectral documentation quoted for that section. Arms are the unmixing setups compared; donors (A3, A6, B11, B2, D1) are the replicates. "Losing most of the spike" means less than half of a +1 arcsinh spike is recovered in a cell.

```{r}
#| label: body
#| results: asis
# One section per report heading -------------------------------------------------------------
# Built as child markdown so each reactable keeps its HTML dependencies.
render_section <- \(which_heading, prose) {
  figs <- filter(figures, heading == which_heading)
  notes <- autospectral_notes(prose)
  lines <- c(sprintf("## %s", which_heading), "", finding(prose), "")
  if (nrow(figs) > 0 || length(notes) > 0) {
    lines <- c(lines, "::: {.panel-tabset}", "")
    if (nrow(figs) > 0) {
      lines <- c(lines, "### Figures", "")
      lines <- c(
        lines,
        pmap_chr(figs, \(caption, rel, web, ...) {
          sprintf("![%s `%s`](%s){width=100%%}\n", caption, rel, file.path("../../..", web))
        })
      )
      lines <- c(lines, "### Data", "")
      for (i in seq_len(nrow(figs))) {
        lines <- c(
          lines,
          sprintf("**%s**", basename(figs$rel[i])),
          "",
          sprintf("```{r, results='asis'}\ntab <- data_table(%s)\ncat(tab$note)\n```\n", deparse(figs$path[i])),
          sprintf("```{r}\ntab$widget\n```\n")
        )
      }
    }
    if (length(notes) > 0) {
      lines <- c(lines, "### AutoSpectral notes", "", paste0("- ", str_remove(notes, "^- ")), "")
    }
    lines <- c(lines, ":::", "")
  }
  knitr::knit_child(text = lines, envir = environment(), quiet = TRUE)
}
# Section 08 points at the superseded offline dashboard that this page replaces.
out <- pmap_chr(select(filter(sections, !str_starts(heading, "08 ")), heading, prose), \(heading, prose) render_section(heading, prose))
cat(out, sep = "\n\n")
```
